name: Transco Virginia Southside Expansion Project
researcher_notes: Not in the roster under any name. The roster has no Virginia Southside row. P3200 and P5990 are the cancelled VNG Interconnect and are different. P0271 is the system row. A 2012 Federal Register notice for FERC docket CP13-30 describes 91.4 miles of new 24-inch loop on the South Virginia Lateral plus 7.2 miles of new greenfield pipe in Brunswick County, 98.6 miles in all, starting in Pittsylvania County and ending in Brunswick County. A September 2015 Pipeline and Gas Journal report says Transco placed the project in service, about 100 miles of 24-inch pipe, 270,000 Dth per day of added capacity, and a cost of $300 million. The notice states a proposed 250,000 Dth per day, and the 270,000 figure is the as-built number. Length uses the 98.6 miles in the notice. Adds well over 25 km of new pipe. The EIA historical sheet also lists the project as completed 2015 (about 100 miles, 270 MMcf per day) but the dated release URL was not verified, so it is not cited. A smaller Virginia Southside Expansion Project II (4.9 miles, 2017) is a separate project below the length threshold. Route not researched in this pass. Row follows the Hillabee P2544 naming shape. Tier high, two independent publishers.
